_comment: Authoritative role->backend routing for the multi-agent layer. Each role declares a PRIMARY backend (provider+model) and an emergency `fallback` provider. provider `claude-code` == Claude (CLI, Claude Max subscription). 2026-07-16 (Option B): the engine went 100% Claude — scout/analyst/synthesizer + default all run on the claude-code CLI (Opus 4.8 for the three roles, Sonnet for default). 2026-07-23: ALL local model runtimes are now GONE from this machine — LM Studio was decommissioned 2026-07-16 and Ollama was fully uninstalled 2026-07-23 (binaries, LaunchAgents, TLS proxy :11435 and 9.2GB of models). The `local` provider block was deleted from llm-providers.json. All fallbacks are "" (empty) so a primary claude-code failure surfaces the real error instead of chasing a removed backend.
_memory_note: All three core roles run on Claude Opus 4.8 via the claude-code CLI (flat-rate Claude Max subscription, no API key, 1M context); unmapped roles + `default` stay on claude-code/claude-sonnet-4-6. The engine uses NO local models, and as of 2026-07-23 none exist on the machine at all — the Obsidian side (Copilot chat + vault-zettelkasten + wiki definitions) also moved to the hosted copilot-plus-flash model.
